plain: Settling a dispute by a neutral judge instead of a court.

webster.text: The hearing and determination of a cause between parties in controversy, by a person or persons chosen by the parties.

example.quote: The honorable gentleman said that the consent of the parties was necessary : I say that a previous consent mio;ht leave it to arbitration.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 20, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
